title: Dark Castle (1986) - Original Macintosh Version!
summary: Gameplay footage of the original 1986 Macintosh version of Dark Castle by Silicon Beach Software. The uploader argues the original is a great game that was tarnished by inferior ports.
why: HN uses it to show a classic early Mac game, noting its low-latency input and early audio showcase.

quote.text: arguably the best non-educational game for the original Macintosh
